Humanoid (Goblinoid) · 1 hex · SM +0 Hobgoblin [Monsters on Automatic, SRD coverage: humanoid folk and their sub-races; answers Hobgoblin (SRD 5.1); Hobgoblin (SRD 3.5)]

The goblinoid that got organised. Hobgoblins drill, post sentries, hold a line when it is losing and rotate the front rank while doing it — which makes six of them a harder problem than twenty goblins and a considerably worse surprise. They are not frightened of adventurers. They have a standing plan for adventurers.

Notes

  • GCS ancestry draft: gcs/hobgoblin.gct
  • Independent build total: 79 points of racial traits plus 22 points of racial skills.
  • Answers the SRD heading(s): Hobgoblin (SRD 5.1); Hobgoblin (SRD 3.5). Only the creature identity is taken from the SRD; the GURPS statistics, ratings and prose are this project's own work and reproduce no SRD text.
  • Typical Stats, damage and ratings are derived from the racial template, not authored beside it, so the sheet and the stat block cannot disagree.
  • Body mass used to scale this build: 90 kg. ST, Size Modifier and DR are checked against it; see the gurps-animal-sanity-check skill for the bands.
  • Movement: ground Move 5 (primary). The published Move is the primary medium's cruising Move; sprint figures are stated here and not folded into it.
  • Treasure and grappling are not authored for this batch and ship as explicit nulls; `lair` carries a short habitat note, because where a wandering animal dens is an encounter fact rather than a loot one.
  • About 1.9 m standing, which is the SM 0 row.
  • ST 12 from Basic Lift: a soldier's frame carrying a soldier's load all day.
  • Combat Reflexes and Fearlessness are the record. A hobgoblin without them is an orc in better kit, and the whole reason the creature exists is that it does not break.
  • Mail and a shield are standard issue and are not in this record's DR. This is the record in the batch where that decision costs the most, and it is stated rather than quietly compensated for. See decision 11 in the build policy.
